summary: #edu407 Honestly I am not the biggest fan of guided reading at least not how it plays out in most schools. It is commercial tool. I find the leveling of groups contrived and devoid of content knowledge. The connection of word study to the text rarely makes sense.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: #edu407 Honestly I am not the biggest fan of guided reading at least not how it plays out in most schools. It is commercial tool. I find the leveling of groups contrived and devoid of content knowledge. The connection of word study to the text rarely makes sense.
